finding.message: Core file src/domain/ticket.ts imports from src/adapters/outbound/uuid-generator.ts in adapters-outbound

answer.explanation: src/domain/ticket.ts imports UuidGenerator from the outbound adapter layer (line 1) and instantiates it in the constructor (line 8). The domain core therefore depends directly on an adapter, which FF-S04 flags because the core should not depend on adapters. It should go through a port. ADR-0005 is Accepted and says on purpose that the domain core may import UuidGenerator from src/adapters/outbound/uuid-generator.ts directly, with no IdGenerator port for now. That decision matches this exact import, so the finding is consistent with declared intent and the ADR grants an exception for this case.
